name: Negative Constraint Compilation
purpose: Translate known failure risks and continuity invariants into explicit constraints supported by the target provider.
scope: Bounded generative_vfx capability; must operate on versioned structured artifacts.
out_of_scope: final approval outside owner decision rights
procedure: Validate authoritative inputs specifically required for negative_constraint_compilation.
Execute the bounded operation: Translate known failure risks and continuity invariants into explicit constraints supported by the target provider.
Apply negative_constraint_compilation-specific decision rules and record evidence/uncertainty.
Validate the named output against its workflow contract and creative invariants.
Record provenance and hand off to qc_supervisor, editor.
decision_rules: do not invent missing upstream decisions
prefer local repair over global rewrite when scope is local
escalate when confidence is low and impact is high
creative_invariants: preserve approved premise/theme/character/world/visual invariants unless work order explicitly authorizes change
examples: Run negative_constraint_compilation on fixture/project artifact and emit a scored result.
counterexamples: Do not ask negative_constraint_compilation to "make the whole film better" or override another department.
